description: This Java class configures Spring Security for the application, including JWT authentication, security schemes, and access rules for different endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class that defines security filters, authentication providers, and endpoint access rules.

methods.name: authenticationJwtTokenFilter
methods.description: Creates a JWT authentication filter bean.

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Creates a DAO authentication provider with user details service and password encoder.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Provides the AuthenticationManager bean from the authentication configuration.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Creates a BCryptPasswordEncoder bean for password hashing.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures the HttpSecurity object with CSRF disabled, stateless session management, endpoint access rules, and custom filters.
